ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached structure is the glycinium cation in brackets with an overall positive charge. It shows an ammonium end, H3N+-CH2-, connected to a carboxylic acid group, -C(=O)-OH. The arrows label labile protons with pK_a = 9.6 at the ammonium H and pK_a = 2.3 at the carboxyl OH. Reasoning: Following the carboxylic acid portion shown in the image, the relevant fragment is -CH2-C(=O)-OH. The carboxyl carbon is bonded to three groups: the adjacent carbon, the double-bonded oxygen, and the hydroxyl oxygen. A carboxyl carbon is sp2-hybridized and trigonal planar, so these three attached atoms and the carboxyl carbon lie in one plane. Therefore the adjacent carbon, the carboxyl carbon, and the two oxygen atoms are coplanar.
